name: drop2run
description: Publishes what an AI made — a page, a markdown or PDF doc, or a whole site — to a live HTTPS link.
long_description:
Give Claude a page it just wrote, a report, a folder of notes or a built site, and get back a URL anyone can open.

A site needs an `index.html` at its top level. Without one, markdown, PDF, Word (`.docx`), Excel (`.xlsx`) and EPUB files publish as a documents site, read through a viewer with a file tree, code highlighting, Mermaid diagrams and KaTeX maths — so a note is a whole publish that needs no wrapping in HTML.

Signing in happens in a browser window; no token is pasted by hand and no command line is involved.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Signs in through a browser on this machine and stores an access token.

tools.name: login_code
tools.description: Signs in with a short code where no browser can be opened on this machine.

tools.name: publish_files
tools.description: Publishes files written in the conversation as a site, and returns its URL.

tools.name: publish_dir
tools.description: Publishes a folder from disk — a site or a set of documents — and returns its URL.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the sites on this account, so a publish can go to one of them.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: Lists the folders on this account, so a new site can be filed in one of them.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Takes a site down permanently, including its subdomain. Requires the subdomain repeated back as confirmation.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Reads a site's settings, whether it is paused, and its versions.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Changes a site's name, serving mode, password, forms, scheduled takedown or folder.

tools.name: pause_site
tools.description: Takes a site off the air without deleting its files or subdomain.

tools.name: resume_site
tools.description: Puts a paused site back on the air.

tools.name: rollback_site
tools.description: Serves an earlier version of a site again, without publishing anything.
